001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
006
007/**
008 *
009 * @author jimmy
010 */
011public abstract class IrAbstractString implements IrStringExpr {
012
013    private final Domain[] charDomains;
014    private final Domain lengthDomain;
015    private final boolean isConstant;
016
017    IrAbstractString(Domain[] charDomains, Domain lengthDomain) {
018        this.charDomains = Check.noNulls(charDomains);
019        this.lengthDomain = Check.notNull(lengthDomain);
020
021        for (Domain c : charDomains) {
022            if (c.getLowBound() < Character.MIN_VALUE) {
023                throw new IllegalStringException();
024            }
025            if (c.getHighBound() > Character.MAX_VALUE) {
026                throw new IllegalStringException();
027            }
028        }
029        for (int i = 0; i < charDomains.length && i < lengthDomain.getLowBound(); i++) {
030            if (charDomains[i].isConstant() && charDomains[i].getLowBound() == 0) {
031                throw new IllegalStringException();
032            }
033        }
034        for (int i = lengthDomain.getHighBound(); i < charDomains.length; i++) {
035            if (!charDomains[i].contains(0)) {
036                throw new IllegalStringException();
037            }
038        }
039        if (lengthDomain.isEmpty()) {
040            throw new IllegalStringException();
041        }
042        if (lengthDomain.getLowBound() < 0) {
043            throw new IllegalStringException();
044        }
045        if (lengthDomain.getHighBound() > charDomains.length) {
046            throw new IllegalStringException();
047        }
048        assert lengthDomain.getHighBound() == charDomains.length : "Correct but not optimized.";
049        this.isConstant = lengthDomain.isConstant() && Arrays.asList(charDomains).stream().allMatch(Domain::isConstant);
050    }
051
052    @Override
053    public Domain[] getChars() {
054        return charDomains;
055    }
056
057    @Override
058    public Domain getLength() {
059        return lengthDomain;
060    }
061
062    @Override
063    public boolean isConstant() {
064        return isConstant;
065    }
066
067    @Override
068    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
069        if (obj instanceof IrAbstractString) {
070            IrAbstractString other = (IrAbstractString) obj;
071            return Arrays.equals(charDomains, other.charDomains)
072                    && lengthDomain.equals(other.lengthDomain);
073        }
074        return false;
075    }
076
077    @Override
078    public int hashCode() {
079        return Arrays.hashCode(charDomains) ^ lengthDomain.hashCode();
080    }
081}
